confirmation-message:
Your transaction has been submitted!
It will show up in your history after mining a few blocks.

receive.tooltip-emoji-id-text: This is your Emoji ID. It can be used as an alternative to your regular txn address to send and receive XTM.

keychain.warning:
Keychain access is required for this operation.
Please try again and select “allow”.

pin.approve-send-subtitle: Enter your PIN to authorise this transaction. If you did not start it, close this dialog.
pin.creation-subtitle:
Set a secure PIN code to protect your wallet on this device.
Your PIN stays private—it’s never stored or shared with Tari Universe.
pin.creation-subtitle-confirm: Enter your PIN again to confirm it is correct.
pin.error-match: That’s not quite right. Try again or create a new PIN.
pin.explainer: If you forget this PIN, the only way to regain access to your wallet is by restoring it from your seed phrase.
pin.forgot-monero-warning: Your Monero wallet is protected by the PIN you forgot. Enter your Monero seed words to keep it, or continue and Tari Universe will create a new Monero wallet for you.
pin.forgot-monero-replace: Continue and create a new Monero wallet
pin.restore-wallet-details: Your wallet details were missing from the settings file. Enter your PIN to restore them from your wallet keys. Nothing else will change.
pin.seed-needs-pin: Your wallet keys are protected by a PIN, but your settings say no PIN is set. Your seed is safe and nothing has been changed. Enter your PIN to continue.
pin.approve-burn-subtitle: Enter your PIN to burn these funds. Burning cannot be undone; only the L2 claim key can recover them. If you did not start this, close this dialog.

reminder.description:
You haven't secured your wallet yet. Backing up your seed phrase keeps your tokens safe and ensures only you can access them.
Let's do it now—it'll only take a moment
reminder.title: Protect your Tari

security.seedwords-empty: Add seed words to restore another Tari Address

send.completed-text: Your transfer submission is now complete and will be broadcast.
send.confirm-subtitle: This transaction was requested from within the app. Approve it only if you started it.
send.processing-text: Your transfer is processing. This can take a few minutes.
send.processing-title: Your XTM is on the way!

swap.buy-tari-subtitle: Buy Tari from any of these supported exchanges.
swap.no-other-tokens-available: No other tokens available to select.
swap.please-confirm-approval-in-wallet: Please confirm approval in your wallet
swap.scan-qr-code: Scan the QR code to connect your wallet on your phone
swap.sign-message: Sign the message on your mobile device
swap.sign-message-text: Approve this transaction using Metamask on your mobile device. Once it has been signed, your transaction will be processed.
swap.transaction-could-not-be-completed: The transaction could not be completed
swap.you-will-receive: You will receive {{symbol}} in (Tari wallet address)
swap.your-purchase-is-processing: Your purchase is processing. This can take a few minutes.
swap.your-xtm-is-on-the-way: Your XTM is on the way!

sync-message.tooltip-description: This was your last synced balance, we'll update it once the wallet is ready.
sync-message.tooltip-description-mining: This was your last synced balance, we'll update it once the wallet is ready. But don’t worry, you’re actively mining and earning XTM.
sync-message.top-line: You are now mining Tari XTM

burn.title: Burn to L2
burn.warning: Burning destroys these funds on L1. They can only be claimed on L2 with the private key matching this claim public key. This cannot be undone.
burn.error-invalid-claim-key: The claim public key must be 64 hex characters
burn.processing-text: Your burn is being broadcast. This can take a few minutes.
burn.completed-text: Once the burn is mined, the L2 claim proof will be written to:
burn.claim-key-default: The claim key defaults to this wallet's own L2 account.

l2.title: Layer 2
l2.pin-required: You must set a PIN to use Layer 2
l2.enable-description: Layer 2 uses a wallet made from your existing seed words. You'll be asked for your PIN.

send.error-invalid-address: That isn't a valid Layer 2 address for this network
send.processing-title: Your XTR is on the way
send.processing-text: Working out the fee and submitting. This can take a minute.

claim.title: Burns to claim
